description: This file defines an abstract class DiagnosticInformation and template classes/functions for creating diagnostic information objects, utilizing dependency injection with the Fruit library. It appears to be part of a diagnostic or reporting subsystem within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: DiagnosticInformation
classes.description: Abstract base class for diagnostic information, providing a virtual destructor, a pure virtual Diagnostics() method, and a static PrintAll method.

classes.name: DiagnosticInformationFn
classes.description: Template class inheriting from DiagnosticInformation, representing a diagnostic info object generated by a function Fn with specified return type R and arguments Args.

methods.name: Diagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic strings generated by the function Fn, depending on its return type.

methods.name: PrintAll
methods.description: Static method to print all diagnostic information objects.
